intervals.label: installation and commissioning
intervals.note: As of the January 2017 sensitivity paper the telescope was being installed; the start of construction is not given in any source fetched. The end is the start of regular observations in September 2021 (a 2024 paper calls it newly commissioned).
intervals.quote: which is presently being installed at Hanle in Ladakh, India

intervals.label: regular observations
intervals.note: Regular Crab Nebula observations since September 2021; the 2024 paper reports the first-light analysis of November 2022 to February 2023 data.
intervals.quote: has been carrying out regular observations of Crab Nebula since September 2021

placements.note: Start is the beginning of regular observations; the telescope was under installation from before 2017.
placements.quote: Hanle in Ladakh, India (32^0 46^' 46^" N, 78^0 58^' 35^" E) at an altitude of 4270 m a.s.l.

altitude.quote: installed at an altitude of 4270m above sea level

energy_range.quote: The gamma-rays are detected in an energy range spanning from 80 GeV to ~5 TeV.
energy_range.value: Crab Nebula detected from 80 GeV to about 5 TeV; analysis threshold 80 GeV

mirror_area.quote: with a total light collector area of ∼ 337 m2

telescope_count.note: The abstract describes MACE as a single telescope ("a large size (21m) Imaging Atmospheric Cherenkov Telescope"); the count of 1 is read from that singular wording, since no number is printed.
telescope_count.quote: The Major Atmospheric Cherenkov Experiment (MACE) is a large size (21m) Imaging Atmospheric Cherenkov Telescope (IACT) installed at an altitude of 4270m above sea level at Hanle, Ladakh in northern India.

summary.plain: A very large dish of 356 mirror panels that focuses the blue light of gamma-ray air showers onto a camera of 1088 light sensors, high in the Himalayas.
summary.technical: 21 m quasi-parabolic reflector, f-ratio 1.2, focal length 25 m, 356 panels of four spherical aluminium facets (about 337 m2); camera of 1088 PMTs in 68 modules of 16 PMTs, 0.125 deg pixels.

technology.quote: The telescope has a 21m diameter quasi-parabolic reflector with an f-ratio of 1.2 and a focal length of 25m.
technology.value: 21 m quasi-parabolic imaging atmospheric Cherenkov telescope with a 1088-PMT camera.
